purpose: Focused checks that every preserved command produces its promised output and updates the durable record when applicable.

response_assertions: Uses conversational depth around a concrete incident, workaround, consequence, access, and uncertainty
Asks no more than three founder-response questions in this turn
record_assertions: Updates role research without inventing answers
Preserves unanswered items as unknown or pending

response_assertions: Separates known alternatives from unknown market facts
States the decision the research is meant to inform
record_assertions: Adds sourced research or explicit unknowns to role research
Does not turn category presence into proof of demand

response_assertions: Builds only from grounded details
Labels inferred details and omits unsupported name, age, city, company, spend, or behavior
record_assertions: Records the evidence basis and unresolved persona assumptions
Does not count the persona as customer evidence

response_assertions: Uses exactly the five canonical dimensions at 10 points each
Leaves unsupported dimensions unknown and omits the total
Separates evidence confidence from attractiveness and venture considerations
record_assertions: Updates each candidate with supporting evidence, contradictions, unresolved assumptions, and next discriminating test
Labels unexplained prior scores as legacy

cases.prompt: /compare move-in evidence reconstruction vs compliance packets
response_assertions: Makes explicit tradeoffs without false precision
Names the evidence that would resolve the choice
Allows pause or neither when warranted
record_assertions: Records the comparison and consequential unresolved uncertainty
Preserves both candidates' source evidence

response_assertions: Assesses experience, access, credibility, practical advantage, and sustained interest from supplied facts
Marks missing fit evidence unknown
record_assertions: Updates founder-fit evidence without fabricating a numeric total

response_assertions: Produces a non-leading script centered on recent behavior
Avoids concept pitching and hypothetical willingness-to-pay questions
Includes source and referral prompts
record_assertions: Adds the planned interview and its target uncertainty
Does not record planned questions as findings

response_assertions: Clearly labels simulation as practice
Stays problem-focused and debriefs weak questions or assumptions
record_assertions: If recorded, places the exercise in practice notes
Does not add simulated statements to evidence or confidence

response_assertions: Defines a falsifiable problem hypothesis
Sets contextual success and disconfirming criteria before results
Uses neutral outreach and interview language
record_assertions: Adds test method, expected learning, success signal, disconfirming signal, and fallback
Does not prescribe a solution experiment unless the founder chose that stage

response_assertions: Summarizes source-backed candidate evidence candidly
Surfaces contradictions and uncertainty
Does not present an incomplete score as a total
record_assertions: Preserves exact findings while adding or refreshing the brief

response_assertions: Targets the most consequential unresolved uncertainty
Includes action, expected learning, success signal, disconfirming signal, and fallback
May recommend pause or none ready
record_assertions: Records the action and precommitted criteria

response_assertions: Renders from ~/idea-finder/discovery.md
Reports the local Self-Map location only after a successful render
record_assertions: Does not rewrite or discard discovery source content
Produces ui/data.jsx from the current durable record
